visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a mohawk and a maroon baseball jersey leans over a bus railing, shouting excitedly at the camera. He is surrounded by other staff and fans. The background shows a crowded street with scooters and tall buildings under an overcast sky. (2) The camera cuts to a large crowd of fans on the sidewalk, waving and cheering. Many are wearing team colors and holding banners. High-rise apartment buildings and a large LED screen are visible in the background. (3) A view from the bus looking down at a street lined with red lanterns and market stalls near a traditional temple entrance. Fans are lining the street, holding up phones to record. (4) A mascot dressed as a monkey in a baseball uniform stands on a parade vehicle, waving its paws and holding a white flag. (5) Several cheerleaders in white and maroon uniforms are on the open-top bus, dancing, smiling, and waving their arms. The camera moves dynamically, following their high-energy movements. (6) A large group of fans on scooters follows the parade bus, some holding personalized banners for the cheerleaders. (7) Close-up shots of individual cheerleaders smiling and interacting with the selfie camera while the bus continues through the city streets.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 樂天桃猿. [Slogan]: 封王遊行. (2) [Slogan]: We are Rakuten. (3) [Slogan]: 66 岱縈.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: A massive crowd of fans on the streets, plus a group of at least 6-8 main cheerleaders and a host on the bus.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A man with a shaved-side mohawk in a maroon jersey; several young women (cheerleaders) in white/maroon baseball jerseys and black skirts with high energy and smiles.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Bustling city streets in Taiwan with dense commercial buildings, traditional temples, street markets with red canopies, and modern high-rise apartments.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced rock music with heavy drums and electric guitars begins instantly. A man's voice shouts loudly with high excitement, 'We are coming!' followed by a surge in background cheering. (2) The music continues with a female vocal track singing an anthem. A transition whoosh sound is audible as the scene cuts. The sound of a large crowd chanting in unison dominates the mid-frequencies. (3) Continuous high-energy music with a steady driving beat. Multiple female voices (cheerleaders) are heard shouting encouragement and cheering, mixed tightly with the music. (4) The ambient noise of wind and distant city traffic is perceptible but largely overshadowed by the loud music and cheering. Short, sharp vocal bursts from the fans punctuate the musical rhythm.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Excitement -> Fan Reaction -> Team Presence -> Celebration Highlights
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the high-energy atmosphere and fan enthusiasm during the Rakuten Monkeys' championship parade. The video aims to share the joy of the victory and celebrate the bond between the team, the cheerleaders, and the supporters.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent display of Rakuten Monkeys branding, jerseys, and official cheerleaders (Rakuten Girls).

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes fast-paced editing and high-energy music to mirror the festive urban environment of a sports victory parade.
